leak.assumption: Each trial independently has a perfect ordinary leak with probability epsilon, otherwise an independent uniform blind guess
leak.identity: Any independent information mechanism with the same per-trial hit probability q has this same binomial hit-count law; hit counts cannot identify the mechanism

preselectedSubset.interpretation: Fixed/preselected compromised subset of exactly m trials, all correct; remaining n-m independent uniform blind trials. This is the stated worst case for at most m preselected compromised trials.

arbitraryOutcomeCorruption.interpretation: At most m entries of the underlying n-trial independent blind-guess vector may be changed after outcomes. Success can increase by at most m; this is the corresponding conservative tail bound.

contaminationGrid.limitation: m is an assumed sensitivity parameter, not estimated, measured or certified; do not substitute preselected-subset tail for outcome-dependent corruption
